auditMetadata.auditName: Phase C2 Closure Audit & C3 Readiness Assessment
auditMetadata.auditorRole: Principal Software Architect, Senior Full-Stack Engineer, WebRTC Specialist, PostgreSQL Auditor, QA Automation Lead
auditMetadata.verdictSummary: Core C2 application features (adaptive video grid, camera-off fallback, deterministic avatar generation, screen-sharing canvas with replaceTrack, in-call colleague search, and 5-peer backend limit with multi-tenant isolation) are fully implemented and functionally robust. Historical data integrity is 100% verified (119 baseline records match SHA-256 bit-for-bit). However, the Playwright E2E test script contains 8 simulated or hardcoded assertions that inflate the 20/20 pass rate without full empirical browser validation.

scenarios.details: DOM attribute data-camera-off toggled to true and avatar container rendered in live browser context.

scenarios.name: Initials Fallback When No Profile Picture

P1.title: Playwright Test Script Uses Mocked Assertions and Hardcoded Returns
P1.impact: Test suite reports 20/20 PASS, but scenarios 3, 6, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, and 17 do not perform real end-to-end browser assertions against actual media streams or multi-peer mesh connections.
P1.remediation: Enhance verify_phase_c2_adaptive_grid_e2e.cjs before C3 production deployment with automated multi-client peer simulation.

P1.title: P2P Mesh Scalability Hard Ceiling at 5 Peers
P1.impact: Direct WebRTC mesh requires N*(N-1) streams. At 5 peers (20 streams), uplink bandwidth and CPU usage reach critical thresholds on average client machines. Phase C3 must introduce an SFU (e.g. LiveKit) to scale beyond 5 peers.
P1.remediation: Architect Phase C3 around an SFU media router (LiveKit) for group calls > 4 participants.

P2.title: ScriptProcessorNode Deprecation in Web Audio API
P2.impact: Speaking detection uses ScriptProcessorNode which is deprecated in modern W3C specifications in favor of AudioWorkletNode, though widely supported across current browsers.
P2.remediation: Migrate audio level analysis to AudioWorkletNode during Phase C3.
